method_selection.why: The parent curve contains no usable values, so another overfitting diagnosis is unsupported. The remaining clear issue is objective/evaluator mismatch: pointwise BCE can spend capacity learning per-user logit offsets that cannot affect GAUC or nDCG. User-centered BCE removes that irrelevant degree of freedom while preserving the existing BPR term. It is low-cost, portfolio-eligible, and previously measured a +0.0026 gain on Pure; on this much stronger parent, an honest expectation is a smaller near-noise-floor gain of roughly 0 to +0.0015, warranting multi-seed confirmation.

It is metric-aligned and untried, but has no standalone benchmark result and is more implementation-sensitive than the measured-win gauge-fixed objective.

expected_delta_basis: The gauge-fixed-bce method card reports a measured +0.0026 primary gain over a weaker 0.6018-family parent, so a smaller +0.0010 gain is an honest expectation on the stronger node_001 parent.
